posts.title: If You Want ROI From AI Agents, Organise Them Like People
posts.description: AI agent ROI comes from an operating model: scoped roles, accountable owners, clean inputs, risk-based controls, and metrics that prove work moved rather than noise increased.

posts.title: AI Won't Fix Your Org Chart
posts.description: Most engineering organisations skip three foundations before chasing AI productivity. Boundary clarity, technical ownership, and contribution norms matter more than tooling.

posts.title: The Rewrite That Was Really a Resignation Letter
posts.description: A rewrite proposal is not a technical plan. It is the final signal in a feedback loop that has been failing for months. How leadership responds determines whether the engineer stays.
